name: Layout bounds cache telemetry

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown: Instrument the existing Taffy absolute-bounds lookup path to count total `layout_bounds` calls, direct bounds-cache hits, parent-origin cache hits, and parent-origin cache misses. The counters will establish whether prepaint normally requests parent bounds before child bounds and whether a later experiment can safely target the redundant parent recursion/cache lookup.
measurementPlanMarkdown: Before editing source, run three fresh headed Chromium/WebGPU Test Suite DataTable benchmark processes covering DPR 1 and DPR 2. Add diagnostics-only counters through the existing Taffy -> Scene -> WGPU frame-diagnostics surface and assert them in the focused benchmark. Run three equivalent candidate processes plus gpux formatting, tests, native/WASM checks, and warning-denied Clippy. Accept only if all existing rendering/correctness counters remain exact, the new counter accounting is internally consistent, and browser throughput/paced-p95 does not materially regress.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown: Expect most parent-origin accesses to hit because GPUI prepaints parents before descendants, while direct bounds-cache hits should reveal repeated consumer reads. The diagnostic surface must not alter layout behavior, renderer work, dependency versions, shader code, scene ordering, or virtualization.

playwright: Three fresh checkpoint Test Suite processes passed 6/6 DPR projects in headed Chromium with WebGPU enabled and one Playwright worker.
No candidate browser process ran because the first implementation attempt failed the gpui compile/test gate.
rayx: The candidate extended the existing Taffy -> Scene -> WGPU -> browser diagnostic path only, but gpui test compilation rejected the fixed 16-entry diagnostics oracle after the array grew to 20 entries.
All six production and focused Test Suite files were restored exactly to checkpoint a0230916e before finishing the experiment.

decisionMarkdown: Revert. The first implementation attempt omitted the existing fixed diagnostics-array oracle in crates/gpux/crates/gpui/src/taffy.rs. AgentX atomicity forbids patching that omission inside the same experiment. A later experiment may retry the same telemetry mechanism only with the oracle explicitly included in its scope and first patch.
